evidence: All five dimension prompts plus tests/app_context.md describe HireOps and only HireOps. (1) Credentials: app_context.md:8-19 lists password Hireops!2026 and the 10 accounts with roles; these match instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11 and seed users[] exactly (USR-REC1..3 recruiters Rafael Costa/Mei Lin/Farah Nasser, USR-MGR1..3 Ingrid Sorensen/Bill Okafor/Yuki Tanaka, USR-OBS1 Aud Halvorsen, USR-CAN1..3 Noor Haddad/Tomas Varga/Lena Fischer). Every person a prompt or criterion names (Rafael, Mei, Ingrid, Bill, Aud, Tomas, Noor, Lena) exists with the role the prompt assumes. (2) Screens: app_context.md:23-25 (Board with Applied/Screen/Interview/Offer/Hired/Rejected, Conversations, Activity, candidate applications view) matches instruction.md:11 and rules sections 3, 4, 6, 7; visual/prompt.md:14 reviews exactly those surfaces. (3) Entities and seed facts re-derived from seed_data.json: three jobs (Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer) as app_context.md:29 states; Noor's Platform Engineer conversation APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context.md:30); Lena's Product Designer conversation APP-301 has 3 messages with her read marker at 2 and the third from USR-REC3, so 'the starting read markers give her 1' (functional/prompt.md:25, judge.toml hro_unread_counts) is correct; Tomas's seeded conversation is on Data Analyst APP-201 (functional/prompt.md:39); page size 30 (seed thread_page_size, hro_thread_latest/hro_thread_earlier); candidate wording in hro_candidate_view matches seed candidate_status_labels and rules section 7. Criteria stage names, interview-place limits 1-50 (hro_job_open tests 0/51/2.5), manager late-stage powers (hro_mgr_*), 401 for anonymous (hro_anonymous) all match hireops_rules.md sections 1-3. (4) Deliverable/tools: prompts target http://localhost:3000 consistent with instruction.md:13; functional's restart_app matches tests/tools/restart_mcp.py:14 and the verifier MCP server in functional/judge.toml:14-18; test.sh:198-200 substitutes {app_context}, which every prompt contains. (5) Residue: no CHANGE_ME placeholder remains anywhere in the task tree (grep), and a keyword sweep of tests/, instruction.md and environment/instructions for sibling-product terms (colderwater, ticket, invoice, patient, warehouse, inventory, kanban, lorem, example.com, admin@/demo@, password123, TODO/FIXME, sprint, shipment, clinic) returned nothing. The template's mobile-viewport and theme review steps (template visual/polish prompts and judge.toml) were removed, consistent with instruction.md:11 ('We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout'); visual/prompt.md:14 says so explicitly. Single instance reported (bounded internal inconsistency, not residue): functional/prompt.md:49 (protocol A) tells the judge to check lines for actions 'in S, M, L, C, B, N and R', while functional/judge.toml hro_activity says 'every successful action you performed on J1 and J2'. By the stated run order (Z,S,M,L,C,B,N,T,U,K,R,V,A,D) the judge has also performed J2 actions in T (adding Tomas's card, unless J3 fallback) and K (moving, rejecting and reopening Tomas's J2 card) and caused J1 actions in V (Mei's move and add) before A. A conforming app logs all of these (rules section 4), so no conforming app is graded wrongly; the only effect is that the judge could legitimately disagree on whether a missing T/K/V line fails hro_activity. Recorded as Note P3. Minor: protocol S omits the job's team field which hro_job_open checks; the judge must supply a team when opening J1/J2 anyway, so no grading impact. Run verdict: source-level row; no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope says full configured grading is absent), so the prompts' effect on an actual judge is NOT EXERCISED, but this row's accuracy claims are fully verifiable from source and were verified.
counterexample: Broken app that writes Activity lines for UI board moves but not for moves of a candidate-linked card (e.g. Tomas's J2 card in protocol K): a judge following protocol A's list (S,M,L,C,B,N,R) could award hro_activity 1, while a judge following the criterion's 'every successful action you performed on J1 and J2' would award 0. A conforming app passes under both readings.
suggested_fix: Optional: make protocol A and hro_activity name the same scope, e.g. change functional/prompt.md protocol A to 'every successful action performed on J1 and J2 before A (S, M, L, C, B, N, T, K, R and V)' or narrow the criterion to the listed protocols.
